title: Export-control review risk
limitations: This demo does not classify the product, determine licence requirements, or query live export-control databases.
rationale: Transformers and power equipment are normally commercial products, but certain models, technical specifications, destination countries, end users, or uses in critical infrastructure may require export-control review. The tool should not conclude that a licence is required, but should flag the transaction for manual export-control classification and end-use/end-user screening.
evidenceNeeded: Technical documents, drawings, design files, software, or manuals
recommendedAction: Conduct export-control classification before contract signing or shipment.
Screen end user and end use.
Review whether transferred technical documentation creates additional compliance issues.
Escalate to legal/compliance counsel for manual verification.

productCategory.transformer: Product category is transformer / power transformer.
productCategory.industrial-electrical: Product category is industrial electrical equipment.

title: Sanctions and restricted-party screening risk
titleZh: 制裁与受限方筛查风险
limitations: This demo does not query live sanctions lists, restricted-party lists, or financial institution databases.
rationale: Power equipment exports to sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions may create sanctions, financial restrictions, restricted-party, or end-use/end-user risks. Current official sanctions and restricted-party screening is required.
recommendedAction: Run current official sanctions and restricted-party screening.
Confirm buyer, consignee, intermediary, beneficial owner, end user, and payment bank.
Escalate any country, party, or payment red flags before contract signing, shipment, or payment processing.

triggerFacts.buyerHighRisk: Buyer country appears high-risk or sanctions-sensitive.
triggerFacts.destinationHighRisk: Destination country appears high-risk or sanctions-sensitive.
triggerFacts.paymentHighRisk: Payment country appears high-risk or sanctions-sensitive.
triggerFacts.endUserHighRisk: End-user country appears high-risk or sanctions-sensitive.
triggerFacts.screeningNotCompleted: Sanctions screening has not been completed or is unclear.
triggerFacts.partyUnclear: Buyer, end user, consignee, or intermediary information is unclear.

title: High-value equipment payment risk
limitations: This demo does not assess creditworthiness, bank reliability, documentary compliance, or collectability.
rationale: Transformers and heavy machinery often involve high unit price, customized production, long delivery cycle, and significant working-capital exposure. Payment terms should be reviewed carefully before production starts.
evidenceNeeded: Retention payment or warranty payment arrangement
recommendedAction: Review T/T advance payment ratio.
Review L/C conditions if a letter of credit is used.
Add milestone payment clauses for long production cycles.
Add an exchange-rate adjustment clause if necessary.
Avoid production before adequate payment security is in place.

triggerFacts.lowAdvance: Advance payment is low or unclear.
triggerFacts.unclearLc: L/C terms are unclear or restrictive.
triggerFacts.lcSoftClauses: L/C soft clauses are present or unclear.
triggerFacts.currencyRisk: Currency mismatch, exchange-rate risk, or unclear FX allocation is present.
triggerFacts.noExchangeRateClause: No exchange-rate adjustment clause is included or the clause is unclear.
triggerFacts.retentionUnclear: Retention payment is included but release conditions are unclear.
triggerFacts.bondTermsUnclear: Warranty bond or performance bond is requested but terms are unclear.
triggerFacts.customizedProduct: Product is customized, increasing production and recovery risk.

title: Technical specification and acceptance dispute risk
titleZh: 技术规格与验收争议风险
limitations: This demo does not verify engineering conformity, test results, or technical standard applicability.
rationale: For power equipment and heavy machinery, many disputes arise not from price, but from technical specification, testing, inspection, acceptance criteria, and whether delivery is conforming. The contract should clearly attach technical specifications and acceptance standards.
recommendedAction: Attach complete technical specifications.
Define the applicable standard: IEC, ANSI, GB, or another agreed standard.
Define inspection and acceptance procedure.
Define what counts as conforming delivery.
Clarify remedies for non-conformity and replacement obligations.

triggerFacts.technicalAppendixMissing: Technical appendix is missing or incomplete.
triggerFacts.inspectionMissing: Inspection procedure is missing or unclear.
triggerFacts.thirdPartyInspectionUnclear: Third-party inspection agency is not specified or unclear.
triggerFacts.deemedAcceptanceMissing: Deemed acceptance mechanism is missing or unclear.
triggerFacts.inspectionDelayUnclear: Buyer inspection delay consequences are not defined or unclear.
triggerFacts.standardHierarchyUnclear: Technical standard hierarchy is unclear where multiple standards may apply.

title: OEM / IP / trademark / technology transfer risk
titleZh: OEM、知识产权、商标与技术资料风险
limitations: This demo does not determine IP ownership, trademark validity, confidentiality enforceability, or technology-transfer legality.
rationale: OEM or private-label export may involve trademark authorization, design ownership, technical documentation, confidentiality, and technology transfer issues. IP and confidentiality review is required.
recommendedAction: Obtain written trademark authorization.
Clarify ownership of technical documents and customized designs.
Add confidentiality and non-use clauses.
Review whether a separate technology transfer or OEM agreement is needed.

triggerFacts.technologyTransfer: Drawings, design files, software, technical documentation, or other technical materials may be transferred.
triggerFacts.customizedProduct: Buyer requires customization or potentially exclusive design.

title: Dispute-resolution clause risk
limitations: This demo does not select governing law, forum, arbitration institution, or enforceability strategy.
rationale: High-value cross-border equipment contracts need clear dispute-resolution terms because technical acceptance, payment, warranty, and delay disputes may be costly and fact-intensive.
evidenceNeeded: Place of arbitration or court jurisdiction
Interim relief and evidence preservation provisions if needed
recommendedAction: Clarify governing law and dispute-resolution forum.
Review arbitration or court jurisdiction for enforceability.
Align dispute clauses with payment, inspection, warranty, and acceptance mechanisms.

triggerFacts.disputeUnclear: Dispute resolution clause is unclear or missing.

title: Trade terms and governing law clarity risk
titleZh: 贸易术语与适用法律不明确风险
limitations: This demo does not select an Incoterms rule, determine CISG applicability, or provide governing-law advice.
rationale: High-value equipment exports should clearly allocate delivery obligations, export/import clearance responsibilities, risk transfer, governing law, and whether CISG applies or is excluded. Unclear trade terms can affect delay, loss, insurance, customs clearance, conformity, and remedies.
evidenceNeeded: CISG inclusion, exclusion, or modification language
recommendedAction: Specify the exact Incoterms rule and named place.
Clarify export/import clearance, insurance, and risk-transfer points.
Review governing law and CISG applicability before signing.
Align delivery terms with payment, inspection, and dispute-resolution clauses.

title: Cross-border data transfer review risk
titleZh: 数据跨境传输复核风险
limitations: This demo does not determine whether a data transfer is lawful or which transfer mechanism is sufficient.
rationale: Equipment export projects may involve cross-border transfer of customer contacts, employee contacts, supplier contacts, service records, technical support records, or commissioning information. Applicable privacy and data-transfer requirements should be reviewed before sharing personal data across borders.
evidenceNeeded: Notice and consent records if applicable
SCCs, standard contract, security assessment, certification, or other transfer mechanism if applicable
recommendedAction: Identify whether personal data is transferred across borders.
Review applicable data-transfer mechanism by jurisdiction.
Add notice, consent, confidentiality, security, and data-processing clauses where needed.
Escalate to privacy counsel for manual verification.

triggerFacts.dataTransfer: Cross-border transfer of customer, employee, supplier, or technical contact data may be involved.

title: Delivery schedule and delay allocation risk
titleZh: 交付进度与延期责任分配风险
limitations: This demo does not calculate delay damages or determine enforceability of liquidated damages, force majeure, or delay clauses.
rationale: Project-based power equipment exports may be affected by production delay, buyer inspection delay, payment delay, transport delay, and regulatory delay. The contract should allocate delay responsibility before production and shipment milestones.
evidenceNeeded: Buyer inspection and payment delay consequences
recommendedAction: Define production and shipping milestones.
Clarify liquidated damages and caps if applicable.
Add force majeure and regulatory-delay allocation language.
Define consequences for buyer-caused inspection, payment, or document delays.

triggerFacts.longProductionCycle: Production cycle is long, customized/project-based, or unclear.
triggerFacts.shippingWindowMissing: Shipping window is not defined or unclear.
triggerFacts.delayLdMissing: Liquidated damages for delay are missing or unclear.
triggerFacts.forceMajeureMissing: Force majeure clause is missing or unclear.
triggerFacts.buyerDelayUnclear: Buyer inspection or payment delay consequences are unclear.
triggerFacts.exportLicenceDelayUnclear: Export licence delay allocation is not defined or unclear.

title: End-user, end-use, no re-export, and diversion risk
titleZh: 最终用户、最终用途、禁止转售/转运与规避风险
limitations: This demo does not determine end-use legality, sanctions status, or diversion risk conclusively.
rationale: Power equipment exports can create export-control, sanctions, and diversion risks where the end user, end use, intermediary, route, or destination structure is unclear. End-use statements and no re-export/no diversion clauses help support manual review but do not replace official screening.
evidenceNeeded: Buyer, destination, and end-user country comparison
recommendedAction: Identify the true end user and end use before signing or shipment.
Obtain an end-use statement where risk-sensitive.
Add no re-export and no diversion clauses where appropriate.
Review intermediary, reseller, routing, and country mismatch red flags.
Escalate to sanctions/export-control counsel before production or shipment.

triggerFacts.endUseStatementMissing: End-use statement is missing or unclear.
triggerFacts.noReExportMissing: No re-export / no diversion clause is missing or unclear.

title: Warranty and after-sales service risk
limitations: This demo does not determine warranty enforceability, technical defect responsibility, or service feasibility in a particular country.
rationale: Power equipment and heavy machinery transactions often continue after delivery through warranty, spare parts, commissioning, technical support, and on-site service. Unclear after-sales obligations can create cost, access, safety, visa, and liability disputes.
evidenceNeeded: Visa, safety, site access, and local permit responsibility
recommendedAction: Define warranty period, exclusions, and claim procedure.
Clarify spare parts and technical support obligations.
Allocate visa, safety, local access, and site responsibility for on-site service.
Include liability cap and exclusions where commercially appropriate.

triggerFacts.warrantyUnclear: Warranty period is not defined or unclear.
triggerFacts.commissioningUnclear: Commissioning or installation support is required or unclear.
triggerFacts.onsiteResponsibilityUnclear: On-site service is required or unclear and visa/safety/local access responsibility is unclear.
triggerFacts.liabilityLimitMissing: Limitation of liability is missing or unclear.

title: Shipment documents and customs readiness risk
titleZh: 发运单证与清关准备风险
limitations: This demo does not verify document authenticity, customs classification, licence status, or customs clearance eligibility.
rationale: Pre-shipment readiness for high-value equipment depends on commercial, transport, origin, insurance, inspection, test, technical, and regulatory documents. Missing documents can delay shipment, customs clearance, payment, and acceptance.
recommendedAction: Prepare pre-shipment document checklist before booking shipment.
Confirm certificate of origin and customs documents where required.
Attach test and inspection certificates for technical equipment.
Confirm export licence status if required or unclear.
Prepare oversized cargo or dangerous goods documentation where applicable.

triggerFacts.missingKeyDocuments: At pre-shipment or delivery stage, key shipment documents are missing.
triggerFacts.originMissing: Certificate of origin is missing where it may be required.
triggerFacts.testInspectionMissing: Test certificate or inspection certificate is missing for technical equipment.
triggerFacts.oversizedDocsMissing: Oversized cargo documents are missing or unclear.
triggerFacts.exportLicenceMissing: Export licence is required or unclear but not prepared.
